Resolves #18942

A column lock change no longer leaves the moved column's cells in both bodies. `grid.Body#createViewData` defers itself while the body's update is in flight, and `VDomUpdate.registerPreUpdate()` keeps one callback per id. So every call deferred during one flight collapses into one run, and that run carried the **last** caller's arguments. A lock change asks the center body for a forced render (re-bind the cells to the new column set) and then, from the editing path, a plain one. The plain one overwrote the forced one. The run compared only `mountedColumns` (`[0,9]` before and after), recycled every row, and shipped 0 deltas. The center kept a stale `c3` cell in every row, and nothing was queued to correct it. The deferral now merges intent in `#deferredViewData`: the run is forced if any deferred call forced, and it renders if any deferred call asked to render. `grid.Body` is `registerPreUpdate`'s only caller.

Evidence: L2 (e2e + unit tiers, real Chromium; the race is made deterministic by holding the center body's flight) → L2 required (the lost render is an App-Worker ordering visible in the DOM). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC-1 | The mechanism is named by the App Worker trail in #18942's body (measured at `dev@ab2e7cd17c`): forced deferral at t486, runs at t773, forced + unforced deferred at t778 (`replaced: true`), the unforced run at t784, a 0-delta flight at t786. It is neither delta-stream candidate the ticket was filed with |
| AC-2 | `e2e/grid/CellEditingLockedBodies.spec.mjs` › *a lock change that meets an in-flight center-body render moves every cell of the column out of the center*, via the fixture driver's new `lockInFlight` (holds the center body's next flight 300 ms). RED on `dev`'s `Body.mjs` 3/3 (census `0/19/19`), green with the fix 10/10. Unit `grid/DeferredViewData.spec.mjs` pins each half of the merge: see the mutation table below |
| AC-3 | The ticket's stress recipe (LockedBodies + Pooling + TabSuspended, one process, `--workers=12`) on the fix, 25 repeats: **624 / 625**, and the `lockEnd` arm is green in all 25. The one failure is a different arm — `CellEditingPooling` › *a drag inside the editor selects text instead of drag-scrolling the grid*. It flakes at the same rate on `dev`'s `Body.mjs` in a same-head control (60 × 12 workers: fix 2 failed, `dev` 2 failed, fix again 0 failed), so it is pre-existing and captured as a defect-note. Before the fix the lost render reproduced about 1 in 25 recipe runs on @neo-fable's seat and 0 in 75 on mine, so the deterministic arm above — not this rate — is the witness |

## Deltas from ticket

- **The mechanism is neither candidate A nor B.** The forced re-render was never requested: its deferral was overwritten. The ticket body is rewritten with the trail.
- **The silent half.** `grid.View#syncBodies` defers a *silent* `createViewData(true)` on a body in flight, so a render request followed by a scroll's silent pass lost its update the same way. The merge covers it, and the unit arm pins it separately. I tried to pin it end to end first (a scroll sync in the same tick as the lock), but that arm stayed green with the silent merge removed, because the lock's own deferrals land after it. I dropped it rather than ship an arm that cannot fail.
- **CI sighting on a stranger's PR.** @neo-fable saw this on PR #18943's run (`CellEditingReprojectionFocus.spec.mjs:111`, strict-mode violation). The stale center cell carried `neo-locked-end` but kept `aria-colindex="3"` — the recycle signature, confirmed independently.
